events.title: Continental Congress adopts the Declaration of Independence
events.description: Congress approved the final text of the Declaration, drafted chiefly by Thomas Jefferson. Its assertion that all men are created equal, with unalienable rights, became the founding statement of the United States.
events.html: Congress approved the final text of the Declaration, drafted chiefly by Thomas Jefferson. Its assertion that all men are created equal, with unalienable rights, became the founding statement of the United States.

events.title: US Military Academy opens at West Point
events.description: The United States Military Academy formally opened at West Point, New York. It went on to train generations of officers, among them Grant, Lee, Eisenhower and MacArthur.
events.html: The United States Military Academy formally opened at West Point, New York. It went on to train generations of officers, among them Grant, Lee, Eisenhower and MacArthur.

events.title: John Adams and Thomas Jefferson die on the same day
events.description: Former presidents John Adams and Thomas Jefferson died within hours of each other on the 50th anniversary of the Declaration. Adams's reported last words were 'Thomas Jefferson survives', unaware his rival had died first.
events.html: Former presidents John Adams and Thomas Jefferson died within hours of each other on the 50th anniversary of the Declaration. Adams's reported last words were 'Thomas Jefferson survives', unaware his rival had died first.

events.title: Vicksburg surrenders to Ulysses S. Grant
events.description: After a 47-day siege, John Pemberton surrendered Vicksburg and nearly 30,000 men. With Port Hudson falling days later, the Union controlled the Mississippi and split the Confederacy in two.
events.html: After a 47-day siege, John Pemberton surrendered Vicksburg and nearly 30,000 men. With Port Hudson falling days later, the Union controlled the Mississippi and split the Confederacy in two.

events.title: Polish leader Władysław Sikorski dies in a crash at Gibraltar
events.description: General Sikorski, prime minister of the Polish government-in-exile, was killed when his aircraft crashed seconds after take-off from Gibraltar. His death removed the Allies' most respected Polish voice at a critical moment.
events.html: General Sikorski, prime minister of the Polish government-in-exile, was killed when his aircraft crashed seconds after take-off from Gibraltar. His death removed the Allies' most respected Polish voice at a critical moment.

events.title: The Philippines gains independence from the United States
events.description: The Philippines became a sovereign republic after nearly half a century of American rule, as promised by the 1934 Tydings-McDuffie Act. For decades 4 July was celebrated as its Independence Day.

events.title: Mars Pathfinder lands on Mars
events.description: NASA's Pathfinder bounced to a landing on airbags in Ares Vallis and soon deployed Sojourner, the first rover on another planet. The mission returned thousands of images and revived public interest in Mars.
